name.value: Pogue Mahone Irish Pub and Liquor Store

description.value: Pogue Mahone is an Irish-themed pub and liquor store situated in the Brocklehurst neighbourhood of Kamloops, offering classic Irish pub décor alongside a casual sports bar atmosphere. The kitchen serves Irish-inspired and Canadian pub staples — wings, burgers, bangers and mash, fish and chips — supported by 12 taps of draught beer including Guinness. Regular entertainment such as Music Bingo, Karaoke, and Live Music rounds out the experience for anyone settling in after a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active, full-service Irish pub and liquor store with a detailed food and drink menu, daily specials, and entertainment. No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all such fields are null. The OSM name uses 'Alehouse' while the website header reads 'Irish Pub' — a minor discrepancy flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pogue Mahone Alehouse & Liquor Store' but the website header reads 'Pogue Mahone | Irish Pub and Liquor Store' — minor name discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active pub and restaurant that touring cyclists could use as a food and drink stop, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct outreach is needed to verify minimum criteria before including.
